reason: The hypothesis directly restates the approach, mechanism, and conclusions of P11 and P19, which already used DFT-computed Debye temperature, sound velocity, and Grüneisen parameter to explain and predict low thermal conductivity in GeTe-based high-entropy chalcogenides. The proposed intervention is exactly what P11 and P19 did, and the mechanism is taken word for word from those passages. The only new element is the arbitrary 20% improvement claim, which is not justified by any passage.
